snippet.title: PROJECT SONGBIRD | The Horror Game Awards 2025 WORLD PREMIERE
snippet.description:
From the developer of Summerland and We Never Left, Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person psychological horror game where you take on the role of Dakota, a musician who has isolated themself in the remote Appalachian forests of West Virginia to record their next album amidst a writer's block.  Run, hide, fight, and survive your way through this deeply narrative-focused horror story, but tread carefully.  These woods were never empty.

Coming Q1 2026 to Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.

Starring Valerie Rose Lohman, Jonah Scott,  and Aleks Le
Written and Directed by Conner Rush

Wishlist today!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180410/Project_Songbird/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016429
Website: www.fyregames.com
X: https://x.com/FyreGamesReal
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/fyregames.bsky.social
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/conner_w_rush/?hl=en ---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://www.thehorrorgameawards.com/store
